rv.q: At another time when big laughs are badly needed, these eviscerated classics should provide them for most.
This dizzying production leaves us with a general sense of the qualities each actor brings.

cn.t: Critics praise this frantic, gloriously silly sprint through all 37 Shakespeare plays as clever and entertaining, with its mix of pratfalls, audience participation, and lightning-fast characterizations delivering witty brevity in under two hours.
